title: Sync architecture discussion
body: Nora asked why the sync cursor kept corrupting after laptop power loss. I decided the importer should write an append-only journal before advancing the cursor, so recovery can replay the last committed item.

title: commit a91c: journal before cursor
body: Implemented the append-only ingestion journal. The cursor now advances in the same transaction as the durable journal record; interrupted sync replays safely instead of skipping work.
